causes.label: Burner hole or slits on the side of the burner may be clogged.
remedies: Remove the burners (on models with standard twin burners) or burner heads and caps (on models with sealed burners) and clean them with a sewing needle or twist-tie.
Make sure you do not enlarge the holes.
On sealed burner models, check and clean the electrode area for burned-on food or grease.
